events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he’s given us decades of iconic British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles unleashed their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A double album that pushed boundaries and featured some of their most diverse work. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman and music icon Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent and unforgettable stage presence of Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and legacy continue to inspire. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album often cited as a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution. A true classic that still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. Remembering John Lennon, whose songs of peace and love continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic musician and cultural chameleon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His innovative music and fearless artistry continue to shape generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King's music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound, his riffs are etched into rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer and songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Heart
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! A career spanning decades, a voice instantly recognisable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! From Camden Town to global stages, he's given us some of the most memorable British hits.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! His hits defined an era and still sound incredible today. What's your favourite Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The beloved country music icon, Dolly Parton, who passed away on August 25, 2026, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music, spirit, and philanthropy touched millions worldwide. A true legend.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer, songwriter, and television personality Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo success, he's a true British music icon. What’s your favourite song he’s written?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Smooth Operator
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the one and only Billy Ocean! His soulful voice brought us some timeless classics. Which one gets you dancing?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame Induction (1989)
events.blurb: The very first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who do you think was in that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! A key part of Take That's enduring success. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment, solo or with the band?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic and final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert in London. What an incredible way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Award-winning singer, songwriter, and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the phenomenal Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, from Genesis to his incredible solo career. What's your top Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's done it all. What's your favourite JT tune?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles as Del Boy and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: A very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has brought so much joy to our screens. What's your favourite of his iconic roles?
